title: Suitable plan, one false claim
question: I want to start investing for retirement. What would you suggest?

holdings.reason: A broad global core that spreads money across many companies and countries.
Adds UK companies at a very low yearly charge.
A ready-made mix of shares and bonds that steadies the plan.
Bonds that usually move less than shares and pay interest.
A diversified way to benefit from long-term growth in clean energy.

calls.summary: A global core with UK shares, a balanced fund, bonds and a small clean-energy holding.
